purpose: Prototype reference BOM; not an automotive-qualified released BOM.

items.reference: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit
items.notes: 8 GB LPDDR5; up to 67 TOPS; 7/15/25 W module modes. NVIDIA states developer kits are not for production use.

items.reference: 512 GB or larger M.2 2280 NVMe SSD
items.notes: Jetson Orin Nano developer kit exposes M.2 Key-M Type 2280 PCIe storage. Prefer endurance and temperature margin over peak benchmark speed.
DisplayPort-native input is preferred on the Orin Nano developer kit. HDMI-only panels require a separately validated active DisplayPort-to-HDMI adapter.

items.reference: Seeed Studio ReSpeaker XVF3800 USB 4-Mic Array
items.notes: Current XVF3800 reference provides four microphones plus AEC, AGC, DoA, beamforming, VAD, noise suppression, and dereverberation. Cabin validation is still required.

items.reference: Linux UAC-compatible USB audio interface with stereo line output
items.notes: Match output electrically to the vehicle-specific AUX/amplifier integration path; do not directly drive factory digital audio buses.

items.reference: Jetson onboard Wi-Fi/Bluetooth plus user phone USB tether
items.notes: WAN is optional. USB tether is the preferred first uplink; Wi-Fi hotspot is the fallback.

items.reference: Automotive protected DC/DC and ignition/shutdown controller
items.notes: No generic hobby converter is accepted as the vehicle-install reference. Selection requires transient/cold-crank evidence, thermal derating, fuse design, quiescent-current validation, and a regulated rail compatible with the chosen compute carrier.

Linux/SocketCAN-capable reference for bench telemetry. It can transmit, so it is not by itself sufficient for the production v1 receive-only boundary; listen-only and lower-level TX inhibition must be qualified.

items.reference: Momentary physical push-to-talk button through USB HID or isolated GPIO input
items.notes: The control produces only a bounded voice-trigger event. It is not a general GPIO-to-effect bridge.

items.reference: Custom ventilated mechanically restrained compute/power enclosure
items.notes: Final mechanical design depends on vehicle mounting location, airflow, cable strain relief, and service access.
